name: application-email-reading-pane
title: Email Reading Pane
description: A webmail-style reading pane with a reply/forward/archive/delete action bar, a from/to/subject header with sender avatar, and the email body.
useWhen: Building a webmail or in-app messaging client where a selected message renders in a dedicated reading pane beside a message list.
Users need quick access to reply, reply-all, forward, archive, and delete actions for the open message.
avoidWhen: You're composing a new message rather than reading one — use `Compose Window` for the writing surface instead.
The content isn't email — a generic two-pane content view fits better without email-specific header fields (From/To) and actions.
responsiveBehavior: The pane fills its container's width and height, with the action bar and header staying fixed while only the body scrolls in a real implementation with long message content.
accessibility: Every toolbar action (Reply, Reply all, Forward, Archive, Delete) carries a descriptive aria-label since only icons are shown.
The Delete action is visually separated (pushed right) and uses a distinct hover color, signaling its destructive nature beyond position alone.
Sender name, date, and recipients are all rendered as text in the header, giving full context without relying on the avatar alone.

variants.title: Open message
variants.description: An action bar (reply, reply-all, forward, archive, delete), a subject/sender/date/recipients header with avatar, and a formatted email body.
accessibility: Each toolbar icon button carries a descriptive aria-label.

variants.title: Open message (Dark)
variants.description: Email reading pane adapted for dark surfaces, including the toolbar hover states and delete-action color.
accessibility: Header, toolbar, and body text all meet WCAG AA contrast against the dark pane background.
